reason: Five knowledge/search/storage data defects from the round-4 audit. (4) build_chunks hashed only source, page and text, so an XLSX whose sheets repeat a row (EMEA and APAC both starting with Host | Port) produced duplicate chunk ids; Chroma rejects duplicate ids in one upsert, the source was stored as status=error with nothing retrievable, and reindex rebuilt the same ids forever. The section location (sheet + row) is now part of the identity. (10) repair_stale_projection compared every INDEXED_ENTITY_KINDS row against search_documents, but project_search_document deliberately never projects temporary Ask Nebula sessions, so one popup chat made every search run a full rebuild and report partial_index=true; the signature and the row scan now share a predicate that excludes temporary sessions. (25) ArtifactStore inferred media type from mimetypes.guess_type()[0], dropping the encoding, so log.txt.gz was stored and served as text/plain and marked searchable; infer_media_type keeps the encoding (application/gzip, x-bzip2, x-xz) and maps .log/.har/.ndjson. (34) overview() counted temporary sessions while list_entities() and count() hid them; all three now use one not_temporary_chat_session predicate and count() gained the same include_temporary flag. (37) migrate_inline_knowledge_indexes only paged KnowledgeSource, leaving LibraryItem rows with inline metadata.chunks ready but unretrievable; Library items are migrated into the library collection too. Tests: test_repeated_spreadsheet_rows_get_distinct_chunk_ids and test_spreadsheet_with_repeated_rows_indexes_and_reindexes (4), test_temporary_conversations_do_not_keep_the_projection_stale (10), test_media_type_inference_keeps_the_compression_encoding and test_explicit_media_type_wins_over_filename_inference (25), test_count_and_overview_agree_with_list_entities_about_temporary_chats (34), test_startup_migrates_inline_library_chunks_to_chroma (37); each fails on origin/main and passes here, alongside the existing tests in those five files.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through src/nebula/v3/storage.py and search.py) does not exercise XLSX chunk identity, temporary-chat projection repair, artifact media-type inference, overview counts or Library chunk migration; the Python tests drive them directly. No full suites.
